Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon Tokubetsu-hen Anime Overview:

Set against a historical Taisho-era backdrop where supernatural abilities and arranged marriages dictate high-society alliances, the narrative follows Miyo Saimori, a young woman long mistreated by her gifted family because she manifested no psychic powers of her own. Sent away to live with the formidable and cold military commander Kiyoka Kudou, Miyo slowly discovers that her intimidating fiancé is actually deeply compassionate. As they navigate their engagement, Miyo learns to shed her profound insecurities and stand alongside Kiyoka, while supernatural threats continue to loom over the empire, testing their growing bond.

images.alt:
Sazae-san Anime Overview:

Based on the manga by Machiko Hasegawa, Sazae-san follows the daily domestic routines and humorous everyday experiences of Sazae Isono, a cheerful and energetic young woman living in post-war Tokyo. The series centers on the multigenerational Isono family, sharing a household that includes her parents, her husband, her siblings, and her own child. Episodes typically revolve around minor household dilemmas, neighborhood interactions, societal customs, and generational quirks. As a long-running television staple, the program captures the shifting social fabric of Japan through grounded, slice-of-life storytelling that emphasizes traditional family values, community relationships, and the gentle humor found in ordinary routines.

Japanese Title: サザエさん

Official Site: http://www.sazaesan.jp/
